description: Field mapping between MT103 (Single Customer Credit Transfer) and pacs.008.001.10 (FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer). MT103 is used for cross-border customer credit transfers in SWIFT MT format, while pacs.008 is the ISO 20022 XML equivalent for financial institution to financial institution customer credit transfers.
mapping_notes: MT103 uses SWIFT character set (ASCII-based), while pacs.008 supports full Unicode. Character set conversion may be required.
MT103 field lengths are generally shorter than pacs.008 equivalents. MT to MX translation is usually lossless, but MX to MT may require truncation.
MT103 uses comma as decimal separator (e.g., 1234,56), while pacs.008 uses period (e.g., 1234.56)
BIC codes in MT103 are 8 or 11 characters, matching ISO 9362. pacs.008 uses BICFI type with same format.
MT103 field 71A charge bearer codes map to ChrgBr element: BEN->CRED, OUR->DEBT, SHA->SHAR
pacs.008 supports batch transactions (multiple CdtTrfTxInf entries), while MT103 is always single transaction
Some pacs.008 mandatory fields have no MT103 equivalent and must be defaulted (e.g., CreDtTm, NbOfTxs, IntrBkSttlmDt if not derivable)
MT103 Block 3 tag 121 (UETR) maps directly to pacs.008 UETR element for end-to-end tracking

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 20 maps to Instruction Identification. This is the unique reference assigned by the instructing party.
mappings.notes: Both formats use max 35 chars (MT103: 16, pacs.008: 35), so MT to MX is lossless. MX to MT may require truncation if > 16 chars.
mappings.truncation_rule: If MX InstrId > 16 chars, truncate to 16 chars for MT field 20

mappings.transform_details: If MT103 Block 3 tag 121 (UETR) is absent, use field 20 value as EndToEndId. If UETR is present, use UETR for EndToEndId instead.
mappings.notes: EndToEndId is mandatory in pacs.008. Priority: 1) UETR from Block 3:121, 2) field 20 value, 3) generated value if neither available

mappings.transform_details: Block 3 tag 121 contains the Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UUID format). Maps directly to UETR element.
mappings.notes: UETR is optional in both formats but strongly recommended for payment tracking (SWIFT gpi requirement)

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 23B (4-char code like CRED, SPAY) maps to Local Instrument Proprietary code. Common codes: CRED=credit transfer, SPAY=salary payment, SPRI=priority.
mappings.notes: pacs.008 also has LclInstrm/Cd for standardized codes, but MT 23B codes are proprietary, so use Prtry element

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 23E instruction codes map to Instruction for Creditor Agent codes. Mapping: PHOB/PHOI/TELB/TELI->PHON (phone), HOLD->HOLD, etc. Additional info after slash (23E format: CODE/info) goes to InstrInf element.
mappings.notes: Field 23E can repeat in MT103. Each occurrence should create separate InstrForCdtrAgt entry. ISO 20022 codes are more standardized.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 32A date component (YYMMDD format, first 6 chars) maps to Interbank Settlement Date. Convert YYMMDD to ISO date format YYYY-MM-DD.
mappings.notes: Date conversion: YY >= 50 -> 19YY, YY < 50 -> 20YY (common SWIFT convention). Example: 260210 -> 2026-02-10

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 32A currency and amount components map to Interbank Settlement Amount. Currency is chars 7-9 (3-letter ISO 4217 code). Amount follows currency (chars 10+), with comma as decimal separator in MT, period in MX.
mappings.notes: Amount conversion: MT uses comma decimal (1234567,89), MX uses period (1234567.89). Currency becomes Ccy attribute of IntrBkSttlmAmt.

examples.notes: Extract currency EUR and amount 1234567,89, convert comma to period

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 33B (currency + amount) maps to Instructed Amount when present. Used when instructed amount differs from settlement amount (e.g., before currency conversion). Same format as 32A amount portion.
mappings.notes: Optional in both formats. If present in MT103, includes currency and amount. Convert comma to period for MX.

examples.notes: Instructed amount before conversion to settlement currency

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 36 exchange rate maps directly to Exchange Rate element. Convert comma decimal separator to period.
mappings.notes: Used when field 33B (Instructed Amount) is present and differs from 32A (Settlement Amount)

examples.notes: Exchange rate with comma converted to period

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 50A BIC (line 2) maps to Debtor Organization Identification Any BIC. If account line (line 1, prefixed with /) is present, it goes to DbtrAcct/Id/Othr/Id.
mappings.notes: Field 50A indicates ordering customer is identified by BIC (typically a financial institution acting as customer). Not common for individual customers.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 50A account line (optional, line 1, prefixed with /) maps to Debtor Account Identification Other. Remove leading slash.
mappings.notes: Account line is optional in 50A. If present, strip leading slash and map to DbtrAcct.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 50K name and address (up to 4 lines of 35 chars) maps to Debtor Name (line 1 or 2) and Debtor Postal Address (remaining lines). If line 1 starts with /, it's the account; otherwise it's part of name/address.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX Nm element max 140 chars. MT allows 4x35=140 chars across account+name+address. Extract first non-account line as name (max 140 chars).
mappings.notes: Most common ordering customer format. Parse: optional account line (starts with /), then name line(s), then address line(s).

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 50K address lines (after name) map to Debtor Postal Address AdrLine elements. Each line becomes separate AdrLine (max 7 lines in MX, each 70 chars).
mappings.truncation_rule: MX allows up to 7 AdrLine elements of 70 chars each. MT has 4 lines total (name+address) of 35 chars each. Usually sufficient.
mappings.notes: Parse 50K: skip account line if present, use next line(s) for name, remaining lines for address. Address parsing is context-dependent.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 50K optional account line (line 1 if starts with /) maps to Debtor Account Identification. Remove leading slash. Could be account number or IBAN.
mappings.notes: Check if account line is IBAN format. If yes, use DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN instead of Othr/Id.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 50F contains structured party identification with numbered lines. Line 1 (account), line 2 (name/address), line 3 (country/town), line 4 (date of birth). Map to appropriate Debtor elements based on line numbers.
mappings.notes: Field 50F is complex structured format rarely used. Requires parsing numbered lines. If line 4 exists (date of birth), use PrvtId (private person); otherwise use OrgId.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 52A BIC maps to Debtor Agent Financial Institution BIC. This is the financial institution of the ordering customer.
mappings.notes: 52A is the ordering institution (debtor's bank). Do not confuse with 50A (ordering customer).

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 52D name and address (up to 4 lines of 35 chars) maps to Debtor Agent name (first line) and postal address (remaining lines).
mappings.truncation_rule: MX FinInstnId/Nm max 140 chars, PstlAdr/AdrLine max 7x70 chars. MT allows 4x35=140 chars.
mappings.notes: Used when ordering institution doesn't have a BIC or BIC is unknown. Less common than 52A.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 53A indicates the account held by sender's correspondent for reimbursement. Optional account line maps to account identification. BIC is implicit (sender's institution).
mappings.notes: Field 53 is used in correspondent banking to specify reimbursement account. Rarely used in modern payments. No direct MX equivalent for this routing pattern.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 56A BIC maps to Intermediary Agent 1 Financial Institution BIC. This is a bank in the payment chain between sender and receiver.
mappings.notes: Intermediary banks are used in correspondent banking chains. pacs.008 supports IntrmyAgt1, IntrmyAgt2, IntrmyAgt3 for multiple intermediaries.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 56C party identifier (format: /34x) maps to Intermediary Agent Clearing System Member Identification. Remove leading slash.
mappings.notes: Field 56C contains party identifier without name/address. Used when intermediary is identified by clearing system ID rather than BIC.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 56D name and address maps to Intermediary Agent name and postal address. First line is name, remaining lines are address.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX FinInstnId/Nm max 140 chars. MT allows 4x35=140 chars.
mappings.notes: Used when intermediary doesn't have BIC or is identified by name/address only.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 57A BIC maps to Creditor Agent Financial Institution BIC. This is the financial institution servicing the beneficiary customer (beneficiary's bank).
mappings.notes: Field 57 is mandatory in MT103 (one option must be present). This is the beneficiary's bank where the account is held.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 57A optional account line (line 1, prefixed with /) maps to Creditor Agent Account Identification. This is the account at creditor agent used for this payment.
mappings.notes: Optional account line specifies which account at the creditor agent should be credited. Remove leading slash.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 57B location (line 2, 35 chars) maps to Creditor Agent name. Party identifier (optional line 1) maps to account if present.
mappings.notes: Field 57B provides location information rather than full name/address. Less precise than 57D.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 57C party identifier (format: /34x) maps to Creditor Agent Clearing System Member ID. Remove leading slash.
mappings.notes: Field 57C used when creditor agent is identified by clearing system member ID rather than BIC.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 57D name and address maps to Creditor Agent name (first non-account line) and postal address (remaining lines).
mappings.truncation_rule: MX FinInstnId/Nm max 140 chars. MT allows 4x35=140 chars.
mappings.notes: Used when beneficiary's bank doesn't have BIC or is identified by name/address. Parse: optional account line, then name, then address.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 59 name and address (up to 4 lines of 35 chars) maps to Creditor Name (first non-account line) and Creditor Postal Address (remaining lines).
mappings.truncation_rule: MX Nm max 140 chars. MT allows 4x35=140 chars total for account+name+address.
mappings.notes: Most common beneficiary format. Parse: optional account line (starts with /), then name line(s), then address line(s).

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 59 address lines (after name) map to Creditor Postal Address AdrLine elements. Each address line becomes separate AdrLine.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX allows up to 7 AdrLine elements of 70 chars each. MT has max 4 lines total.
mappings.notes: Parse 59: skip account line if present, use next line for name, remaining lines for address.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 59 optional account line (line 1 if starts with /) maps to Creditor Account Identification. If account matches IBAN format, use IBAN element; otherwise use Othr/Id.
mappings.notes: Validate account format: if IBAN (starts with 2-letter country code + 2 check digits), use CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN. Otherwise use CdtrAcct/Id/Othr/Id.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 59 optional account line (if not IBAN format) maps to Creditor Account Identification Other. Remove leading slash.
mappings.notes: Use this when account doesn't match IBAN format. For IBAN accounts, use CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN instead.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 59A BIC (line 2) maps to Creditor Organization Identification Any BIC. Optional account line (line 1) maps to CdtrAcct.
mappings.notes: Field 59A indicates beneficiary is identified by BIC (rare for individual customers, used when beneficiary is a financial institution).

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 59A optional account line (line 1, prefixed with /) maps to Creditor Account Identification. Remove leading slash.
mappings.notes: Account line is optional in 59A. If present, map to CdtrAcct after validating format (IBAN vs other).

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 59F contains structured party identification with numbered lines. Map to appropriate Creditor elements based on line numbers: 1=account, 2=name/address, 3=country/town, 4=date of birth.
mappings.notes: Field 59F is complex structured format. If line 4 exists (date of birth), beneficiary is private person; use PrvtId. Otherwise use OrgId.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 70 remittance information (up to 4 lines of 35 chars, max 140 chars) maps to Remittance Information Unstructured. Concatenate lines with space separator.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX Ustrd max 140 chars per line, can have multiple Ustrd elements. MT has 4x35=140 chars total. Concatenate or split as needed.
mappings.notes: Field 70 contains free-text remittance info like invoice numbers, payment purpose. pacs.008 supports both structured and unstructured remittance info.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 71A charge bearer code maps to Charge Bearer element. Lookup table: BEN->CRED (beneficiary pays all), OUR->DEBT (debtor pays all), SHA->SHAR (shared charges). ISO 20022 uses 4-letter codes.
mappings.notes: SEPA payments require SHA (shared charges). BEN is not allowed in SEPA. Reverse mapping: CRED->BEN, DEBT->OUR, SHAR->SHA.

examples.notes: Beneficiary pays all charges - not allowed in SEPA

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 71F sender's charges (currency + amount) maps to Charges Information Amount with Bearer: DEBT (sender pays). Can repeat; create multiple ChrgsInf entries. Set ChrgsInf/Agt/FinInstnId to sender's institution.
mappings.notes: Field 71F can appear multiple times in MT103. Each occurrence should create separate ChrgsInf entry in pacs.008 with ChrgBr=DEBT.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 71G receiver's charges (currency + amount) maps to Charges Information Amount with Bearer: CRED (receiver pays). Set ChrgsInf/Agt/FinInstnId to receiver's institution.
mappings.notes: Field 71G contains charges deducted by receiving institution. Create ChrgsInf entry with ChrgBr=CRED.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 72 sender to receiver information (up to 6 lines of 35 chars, max 210 chars) maps to Instruction for Next Agent Instruction Information. This contains bank-to-bank instructions.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX InstrInf max 140 chars. MT allows 6x35=210 chars. Truncate if necessary, prioritizing structured codes (e.g., /ACC/, /INS/).
mappings.notes: Field 72 often contains structured codes like /ACC/ (account info), /INS/ (instruction), /BNF/ (beneficiary info). Parse these if present and map to appropriate MX elements.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 77B regulatory reporting information (up to 3 lines of 35 chars, max 105 chars) maps to Regulatory Reporting Details Information. Contains regulatory codes and references.
mappings.truncation_rule: MX RgltryRptg/Dtls/Inf max 35 chars per occurrence, can have multiple Dtls. MT has 3x35=105 chars. Split into multiple Dtls entries.
mappings.notes: Field 77B contains country-specific regulatory reporting info. Format varies by jurisdiction. May contain structured codes.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 13C time indication (format: /SNDTIME/HHMM+offset) can be used to derive GrpHdr CreDtTm if no other source available. Combine with 32A date. More commonly, CreDtTm is set to current timestamp at translation time.
mappings.notes: Field 13C is optional and rarely used. If present, use SNDTIME for message creation timestamp. Otherwise, use translation time as CreDtTm.

mappings.transform_details: MT103 field 26T transaction type code (3-char alphanumeric) maps to Purpose Proprietary. This indicates the purpose/nature of the payment.
mappings.notes: Field 26T codes are proprietary. pacs.008 also supports Purp/Cd for standardized ISO 20022 purpose codes (e.g., SALA=salary, PENS=pension).

mt_only_fields.reason: Field 51A identifies the institution sending the MT103 message. In pacs.008, the sending institution is implicit in the GrpHdr/InstgAgt or message transport headers, not explicitly in transaction details. No direct equivalent in pacs.008 CdtTrfTxInf structure.

Field 53 identifies the correspondent bank account for reimbursement in MT103 correspondent banking model. pacs.008 uses different routing model without explicit correspondent account field. Reimbursement is handled through settlement systems (IntrBkSttlmDt, SttlmAcct).
Same as 53A - correspondent banking concept doesn't map directly to pacs.008.
Same as 53A - correspondent banking concept doesn't map directly to pacs.008.
Field 54 identifies the receiver's correspondent for reimbursement. pacs.008 doesn't have explicit receiver's correspondent field. Routing handled differently.
Same as 54A - receiver's correspondent concept doesn't map to pacs.008.
Same as 54A - receiver's correspondent concept doesn't map to pacs.008.

Field 55 specifies third reimbursement institution in complex correspondent banking chains. pacs.008 routing model doesn't support this concept explicitly. Can potentially map to IntrmyAgt2 or IntrmyAgt3 with loss of semantic meaning.
Same as 55A - third reimbursement concept doesn't map cleanly to pacs.008.
Same as 55A - third reimbursement concept doesn't map cleanly to pacs.008.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Generate unique identifier (UUID or timestamp-based) at translation time. MT103 field 20 could be reused but may not be unique across batches.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 is single transaction message without group header concept. pacs.008 requires GrpHdr/MsgId for message identification at group level.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use current timestamp at translation time. Optionally derive from MT103 field 13C (Time Indication) if present, combined with field 32A date.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 doesn't have explicit message creation timestamp. Field 13C is optional and rarely used. pacs.008 requires CreDtTm.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Set to '1' since MT103 is single transaction. For batch translation, count number of MT103 messages being converted.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 is always single transaction. pacs.008 supports batch transactions, so NbOfTxs is mandatory to indicate count.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use field 32A amount. For batch translation, sum all transaction amounts. Element is optional, can be omitted.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 has no control sum concept (single transaction). pacs.008 CtrlSum is optional but recommended for batch validation.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use MT103 sender BIC from Block 1 (logical terminal address). Extract 8-char BIC from positions 5-16 of Block 1.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 Block 1 contains sender identification but not in same format as pacs.008 GrpHdr. Need to extract from message envelope.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use MT103 receiver BIC from Block 2 (destination address for input messages). Extract from Block 2 Input format.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 Block 2 contains receiver identification but not in same format as pacs.008 GrpHdr. Need to extract from message envelope.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Generate unique identifier or use MT103 field 20. TxId is optional, can be omitted if InstrId and EndToEndId are present.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 doesn't distinguish between instruction ID, end-to-end ID, and transaction ID. pacs.008 has three separate identifiers in PmtId.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Derive from context: if EU payment and ChrgBr=SHAR, use 'SEPA'. If SWIFT gpi (Block 3 tag 121 present), use 'G001'. Otherwise can be omitted.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 doesn't explicitly specify service level. pacs.008 uses SvcLvl to indicate SEPA, gpi, or other service levels. Must be inferred.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Use MT103 field 32A date component. This is usually the value date.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 field 32A contains value date which typically equals interbank settlement date. However, in some scenarios these differ. Direct mapping is common practice.

mx_only_fields.default_strategy: Can be omitted or derived from institutional configuration. Not present in MT103.
mx_only_fields.reason: MT103 doesn't specify settlement account explicitly. pacs.008 SttlmAcct indicates the account used for interbank settlement. Typically configured per institution.
